summary.text: Mike McLane is a Republican member of the Oregon State Senate for District 30, which his legislative page lists as Baker, Crook, Grant, Harney, Lake and Malheur Counties and parts of Deschutes and Jefferson Counties.
His biography describes a 33-year legal career that included service as a circuit court judge.

paragraphs.text: McLane grew up in Condon, Oregon, and lives in Powell Butte in Crook County with his wife, Holly, with whom he raised three children, according to his biography.
He was a law clerk for the Oregon Supreme Court as well as an attorney and circuit court judge.
He was elected to the Oregon House of Representatives five times and served as Republican Leader for six years.

He holds the rank of colonel in the Oregon Air National Guard and has more than 20 years of military service, including assignments with the 173rd Fighter Wing and the Oregon Army National Guard's 41st Infantry Brigade.
